name: Ripple Distortion

strength.description: Peak displacement-map scale of a ripple.

frequency.description: Base noise frequency of the ripple filter.

throttle.description: Minimum time between ripples, in ms.

ambient.description: A very slow, low-amplitude shimmer while the host is in view.

a11y: The duplicated `__warp` layer is `aria-hidden`; only the original `__media` element carries any label or alt text.
With `trigger:"move"` no click is listened for, so clicks are never intercepted.
With `trigger:"click"` the host is not made focusable: the effect is decoration only, and the host's own interactivity (or lack of it) is unchanged.
Reduced motion skips duplicating the media entirely: the image stays static and no filter or listener is attached.
